text:
Elaine: Heads-up — customer ACME-Apps reporting intermittent 503/500s hitting hosted inference around 11:03 UTC. Raised a CS ticket and attached request ids.
Sam (support): Request id rtx_94f2 shows a 500 during toolcall, repeated ~8x in 2m window. Customer notes high concurrency.
Alex (oncall): Where is it failing? any common model or region?
Sam (support): model=gpt-3x-large-quant, region=us-west1, context=4096, batch=8, tool_call=true — all from the same route.
Ella (eng-runtime): I see a runner coredump on runner-42 at same time. Extracted nproc output and a short backtrace. Notable env: LD_PRELOAD=/opt/infer/libprefetch.so present.
Alex (oncall): LD_PRELOAD pattern again? paste logs/snippet please.
Ella (eng-runtime): ```
#0  0x00007f1a2c3a in prefetch_manager::handle_kv(void*) 
#1  0x00007f1a2c5b in start_thread 
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
signal SIGSEGV (Address not mapped to object)
CUDA error: out of memory when copying to device
```
Sam (support): Customer says it surfaces when they hedge toolcalls (duplicate requests) under bursts. They see ~10% failed requests and latency spikes.
Pranav (eng-ml): Possible sequence: prefetch thread allocs/pushes KV -> CUDA mmap/alloc fails on soft-preempt -> cleanup path double-free or uses freed pointer. LD_PRELOAD prefetch shim could be exposing a race.
Alex (oncall): Can repro in dev-rt: stress client qps=120, concurrency=16, toolcall payload with ~3.5k tokens triggers same segfault within ~90s.
Ella (eng-runtime): Repro notes: disable LD_PRELOAD and the segfault doesn't happen; we get graceful OOM and 429s instead. With LD_PRELOAD it's SIGSEGV in prefetch.
Alex (oncall): Immediate mitigation: disable LD_PRELOAD on hosted route for that model/cluster. Start a canary rollback for libprefetch on us-west1.
deploy-bot: Started canary rollback: target=hosted-us-west1, pct=5%, change=remove LD_PRELOAD from runner env, id=r-2026-03-17-ldp-rollback
Ella (eng-runtime): Pushing a guarded fix: check cudaMalloc return and avoid prefetch thread free-after-fail. PR: github.com/redwood/infer/pull/1234 — unit + integration tests in CI.
Pranav (eng-ml): Also adding a repro test to the infer-evals harness to simulate concurrent hedged toolcalls.
Sam (support): Updated customer: we're rolling a canary, temporary mitigation applied, will follow with root-cause and timeline. Customer acknowledged. :thumbsup:
Alex (oncall): Follow-ups: finish hotfix PR, roll to 100% after canary looks good, add alert for LD_PRELOAD-related segfaults and a postmortem. Assigning incident board and CS ticket #C-102233.
Sam (support): Added link to customer logs and support bundle in ticket. Will re-open if failures reappear.
Ella (eng-runtime): Collected full core + nvcrash dump and uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/1759879999/core-runner-42.tar.gz
Alex (oncall): Thanks all — keeping this thread for final postmortem edits.
